subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw add and support the new `agents.entries.*.modelSpend` configuration and per-agent persistent spend-alert state as a core operator feature?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally broad and introduces both a public configuration surface and durable agent-state semantics; code review cannot determine whether those ongoing product and compatibility obligations belong in core.

options.title: Sponsor the core feature
options.body: Accept the per-agent configuration and durable alert state as a supported core contract, then have an owner refresh the draft against current main before merge.

options.title: Require scoped sponsorship first
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until a core owner explicitly confirms the configuration, accounting, retention, and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Close or redirect the proposal if proactive spend alerts should remain an external integration or operator workflow rather than core configuration.

recommendation.title: Require scoped sponsorship first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until a core owner explicitly confirms the configuration, accounting, retention, and upgrade semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the only concrete person connected to the proposed feature scope; a core owner should be added through normal maintainer review before accepting the contract.
